caption:
Here's a fast and challenging Back and Bicep workout for you guys if you're looking to switch things up this weekend. 💪🏻 .
.
.
1️⃣ Start with 2 burnout sets of pullups. Focus on form and using back instead of biceps
2️⃣ Bent over row, 3 sets of 8-12 (until failure)
3️⃣ Seated Low Row  3 sets of 8-12 (until failure)
4️⃣ Single Arm Lat Pulldown (Hammer Machine) Focus on Lat, not biceps
5️⃣ Standing Curl Superset with Bar Hammer Curl (3 burnout sets) .
.
.
For all of these exercises, I try my best to leave my biceps out of the workout and focus on my back. Take the ego out, don't be afraid to go lighter, and spend more time focusing on the targeted muscle. 
Have a great weekend! ❤️
